recommendation: Option A with the recorded limitations. The supported import remains exactly ksdft2effmass.provenance; tools.py had no supported module-path contract and was removed. external_tools.py owns four declaration types, tool_observations.py owns three observation types, and external_execution.py owns six records, three enums, and the internal outcome alias. The package retains 32 exports with unchanged signatures, enum order/values, and frozen/slotted record shapes. The six private validators were removed and intrinsic validation is directly owned. Thirteen class-owned software-verification modules contain 85 functions/evidence owners and 145 collected cases; 24 historical nodes/IDs are preserved one-to-one and 121 nodes are new. Structural validation, 493 provenance cases, 144 focused integration cases, diagnostic branch coverage, Ruff, mypy, Sphinx, serialization/schema/fixture agreement, wheel clean install, ownership/completion/checkpoint/skill/local-route gates, and protected hashes pass. The sole reviewer returned one wording/ownership finding; one consolidated pass removed the unsupported public-alias claim while retaining the explicit human-required internal alias assertion. Software verification does not establish external-tool availability, execution validity, numerical verification, scientific validation, UQ, physical correctness, provenance truth, publication readiness, release readiness, or human acceptance.
